```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Default taken from R notebook behavior: when knitting, wd will always be location of notebook
base_dir <- '..'
Sys.setenv(PEDSNET_SKIP_REQUEST_EXECUTION=1)
tryCatch(source('../site/run.R'),
         error = function (e) message(e)) # May not be able to make db connection

# Set to "local" to read data from ../results, or another value to read from db
data_source <- if_else(config('execution_mode') == 'distribution', 'local', 'not_local')

source(paste0(base_dir, '/code/cohorts.R'))

require(tidyr)
require(knitr)
require(kableExtra)
require(stringr)
require(tibble)
require(ggplot2)
require(eulerr)
require(UpSetR)
require(VennDiagram)
require(gt)
require(gridExtra)
require(plotly)
require(patchwork)

get_results <- function(tbl_name) {
  if (data_source == 'local') {
    rslt <- read_csv(paste0('../results/', tbl_name, '.csv'))
  }
  else {
    rslt <- results_tbl(tbl_name) %>% collect()
  }
rslt
}

prettify_kable <- function(data) {
  rslt <- data %>% kable(digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ','))
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) rslt <- rslt %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = T, border_right = T)
  rslt
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

sites <- get_results('coverage_overlap_pp') %>% site_anon()

cvg <- get_results('coverage_overlap_pp') %>% 
  add_row(site = 'stanford', fact_group = 'med_lab', total_pts_site = 817690,
          total_pts_all = 12318401, n_pts_all = 2440) %>% 
  mutate_all(~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>% left_join(sites) 
output_tbl(cvg, 'coverage_overlap', file = TRUE)
mix <- get_results('case_mix_pp') %>% left_join(sites) 
output_tbl(mix, 'case_mix', file = TRUE)
fot <- get_results('fot_output_distance') %>% left_join(sites) 
output_tbl(fot, 'factsovertime_distance', file = TRUE)
fot2 <- get_results('fot_heuristic') %>% left_join(sites) 
output_tbl(fot2, 'factsovertime_normalized', file = TRUE)
fot3 <- get_results('fot_output') %>% left_join(sites) 
output_tbl(fot2, 'factsovertime_rawcts', file = TRUE)
dcon <- get_results('dcon_output_pp') %>% left_join(sites) 
output_tbl(dcon, 'couplets_og', file = TRUE)
dcon_strict <- get_results('dcon_output_strict_pp') %>% left_join(sites) 
output_tbl(dcon_strict, 'couplets_strict', file = TRUE)

```

## Coverage Overlap
```{r cvg, include=FALSE}

cvg_venn <- cvg %>%
  mutate(fg_venn = case_when(fact_group == 'dx' ~ 'area1',
                             fact_group == 'lab' ~ 'area2',
                             fact_group == 'med' ~ 'area3',
                             fact_group == 'px' ~ 'area4',
                             fact_group == 'dx_lab' ~ 'n12',
                             fact_group == 'dx_med' ~ 'n13',
                             fact_group == 'dx_med_lab' ~ 'n123',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px' ~ 'n14',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px_lab' ~ 'n124',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px_med' ~ 'n134',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px_med_lab' ~ 'n1234',
                             fact_group == 'med_lab' ~ 'n23',
                             fact_group == 'px_lab' ~ 'n24',
                             fact_group == 'px_med' ~ 'n34',
                             fact_group == 'px_med_lab' ~ 'n234')) %>%
  mutate(n_pts_all = prettyNum(n_pts_all, big.mark = ','),
         prop_pts_pct = prop_pts_all * 100,
         venn_display = paste0(n_pts_all, ' \n(', prop_pts_pct, '%)')) %>%
  distinct(fg_venn, venn_display) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fg_venn, values_from = venn_display)

png(filename = paste0(base_dir, '/results/', 'venn_diagram.png'),
    height = 1000,
    width = 1000)
draw.quad.venn(direct.area = TRUE,
               area.vector = c(cvg_venn$area3, cvg_venn$n34, cvg_venn$area4, cvg_venn$n13,
                               cvg_venn$n134, cvg_venn$n1234, cvg_venn$n234, cvg_venn$n24,
                               cvg_venn$area1, cvg_venn$n14, cvg_venn$n124, cvg_venn$n123,
                               cvg_venn$n23, cvg_venn$area2, cvg_venn$n12),
               category = c('Diagnoses', 'Labs', 'Medications', 'Procedures'),
               fill = c('orange', 'red', 'green', 'blue'),
               alpha = 0.3,
               cex = c(2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2),
               cat.cex = c(2, 2, 2, 2))
dev.off()

```

```{r cvg_site}

site_list <- cvg %>% distinct(site_anon) %>% pull()

for(i in 1:length(site_list)){

cvg_venn1 <- cvg %>%
  filter(site_anon == site_list[[i]]) %>%
  mutate(fg_venn = case_when(fact_group == 'dx' ~ 'area1',
                             fact_group == 'lab' ~ 'area2',
                             fact_group == 'med' ~ 'area3',
                             fact_group == 'px' ~ 'area4',
                             fact_group == 'dx_lab' ~ 'n12',
                             fact_group == 'dx_med' ~ 'n13',
                             fact_group == 'dx_med_lab' ~ 'n123',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px' ~ 'n14',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px_lab' ~ 'n124',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px_med' ~ 'n134',
                             fact_group == 'dx_px_med_lab' ~ 'n1234',
                             fact_group == 'med_lab' ~ 'n23',
                             fact_group == 'px_lab' ~ 'n24',
                             fact_group == 'px_med' ~ 'n34',
                             fact_group == 'px_med_lab' ~ 'n234')) %>%
  mutate(n_pts_site = ifelse(n_pts_site < 11, 0, n_pts_site)) %>%
  mutate(n_pts_site = prettyNum(n_pts_site, big.mark = ','),
         prop_pts_pct = prop_pts_site * 100,
         venn_display = paste0(n_pts_site, ' \n(', prop_pts_pct, '%)')) %>%
  distinct(fg_venn, venn_display) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fg_venn, values_from = venn_display)

png(filename = paste0(base_dir, '/results/', 'venn_diagram_', site_list[[i]], '.png'),
    height = 1000,
    width = 1000)
draw.quad.venn(direct.area = TRUE,
               area.vector = c(cvg_venn1$area3, cvg_venn1$n34, cvg_venn1$area4, cvg_venn1$n13,
                               cvg_venn1$n134, cvg_venn1$n1234, cvg_venn1$n234, cvg_venn1$n24,
                               cvg_venn1$area1, cvg_venn1$n14, cvg_venn1$n124, cvg_venn1$n123,
                               cvg_venn1$n23, cvg_venn1$area2, cvg_venn1$n12),
               category = c('Diagnoses', 'Labs', 'Medications', 'Procedures'),
               fill = c('orange', 'red', 'green', 'blue'),
               alpha = 0.3,
               cex = c(2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2),
               cat.cex = c(2, 2, 2, 2))
dev.off()

}
```

## Case-Mix
```{r mix}

mix %>%
  distinct(icd_header, prop_pts_all) %>%
  mutate(pct = paste0(prop_pts_all * 100, '%')) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = icd_header, y = prop_pts_all)) +
  geom_col(fill = '#0c1f63') +
  geom_text(aes(label = pct), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = 'ICD10CM Top Branch',
       y = '',
       fill = '',
       title = 'Representation of ICD10CM Branches (All Site)')
```

```{r mix_site}

site_list <- mix %>% arrange(sitenum) %>% distinct(site_anon) %>% pull()

graph_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(site_list)){
g <- mix %>%
  filter(site_anon == site_list[[i]]) %>%
  distinct(site_anon, icd_header, prop_pt_site) %>%
  mutate(pct = paste0(prop_pt_site * 100, '%')) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = icd_header, y = prop_pt_site)) +
  geom_col(fill = '#0c1f63', show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = pct), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~site_anon, ncol = 1) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = 'ICD10CM Top Branch',
       y = '',
       fill = '',
       title = 'Representation of ICD10CM Branches')

graph_list[[i]] <- g
}

graph_list

```

## Concordance / Couplets
```{r dcon, fig.height=9, fig.width=9}

p1 <- dcon %>%
  filter(site != 'total') %>%
  mutate(pct = paste0(round(prop, 2) * 100, '%')) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=site_anon,y=prop,fill=factor(cohort, 
                                            levels = c('cohort_2_only', 'combined', 'cohort_1_only'))),
           stat='identity') +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = pct), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2,
            fontface = 'bold') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Dark2') +
  theme_test()+
  labs(x="Site (Anonymized)",
       y="Proportion",
       fill = '',
       title = 'Standard Algorithm')+
  facet_wrap(~check_name, ncol = 2)+
  coord_flip()

p2 <- dcon_strict %>%
  filter(site != 'total') %>%
  mutate(pct = paste0(round(prop, 2) * 100, '%')) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=site_anon,y=prop,fill=factor(cohort, 
                                            levels = c('cohort_2_only', 'combined', 'cohort_1_only'))),
           stat='identity') +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = pct), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2,
            fontface = 'bold') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Dark2') +
  theme_test()+
  labs(x="Site (Anonymized)",
       y="Proportion",
       fill = '',
       title = 'Stricter Algorithm')+
  facet_wrap(~check_name, ncol = 2)+
  coord_flip()

p1 + p2

```

## Stability of Facts Over Time

#### Distance from All Site
```{r fot, fig.height=7}

p <- fot %>%
  filter(site != 'all') %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x=month_end,y=distance,group=site_anon,color=site_anon)) +
  facet_wrap(~check_desc, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 2)+
  #scale_color_manual(values=site_colors)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x="Month/Year",
       y = 'Distance',
       fill = 'Site (Anonymized)',
       title = 'Distance from All Site Normalized Mean')

ggplotly(p)
```


#### Raw Patient Counts w/ Smoothing
```{r}
site_list <- fot2 %>% filter(!is.na(site_anon)) %>% arrange(sitenum) %>% distinct(site_anon) %>% pull()

graph_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(site_list)){

g <- fot2 %>%
  filter(site_anon == site_list[[i]]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=month_end,y=row_pts,group=check_desc,color=check_desc)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(color = 'blue', size = 0.25) +
  #geom_line(aes(x=month_end,y=check), color = 'black', size = 0.5, linetype = 'dotted') +
  facet_wrap(~check_desc, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 2)+
  #scale_color_manual(values=site_colors)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  labs(x="Month/Year",
       y = 'Patient Count',
       color = 'Check',
       title = paste0(site_list[[i]], ' Raw Patient Counts w/ Smoothing'))

graph_list[[i]] <- ggplotly(g)
}

htmltools::tagList(graph_list)

```

#### Normalized vs Raw Patients

```{r fot_double}

domain_list <- fot2 %>% distinct(check_desc) %>% pull()

final <- list()

for(i in 1:length(site_list)){
  
  tbl <- fot2 %>%
    filter(site_anon == site_list[[i]])
  
  temp <- list()
  
  for(k in 1:length(domain_list)){
    
    ay <- list(
      tickfont = list(color = "red"),
      overlaying = "y",
      side = "right",
      title = "Normalized Patients")

  plt <- tbl %>%
    filter(check_desc == domain_list[[k]]) %>%
    plot_ly() %>%
    add_lines(x = ~month_end, y = ~row_pts, yaxis = 'y1', name = 'Patients') %>%
    add_lines(x = ~month_end, y = ~check, yaxis = 'y2', name = 'Normalized Patients',
              line = list(color = 'navy', dash = 'dot')) %>%
    layout(
      title = paste0(site_list[[i]], ' ', domain_list[[k]]), 
      yaxis2 = ay,
      xaxis = list(title="Month End"),
      yaxis = list(title="Patients"))
  
  temp[[k]] <- plt
  
  }
  
  final[[i]] <- temp
}

htmltools::tagList(final)

```
